results.title: Gandhi versus Pralhad Joshi: ‘Defended rapists’ remarks by Priyanka, leads to ‘authenticate it’ challenge
results.description: Priyanka Gandhi trained her guns at Joshi during the debate on the anti-paper leak Bill in the Lok Sabha. She was the first MP to attack Pralhad Joshi. She said, “The Prime Minister appointed a new educations minister, a person who expressed consent and even happiness over the release of those convicted of raping pregnant woman.”

results.title: Trump jabs at Netanyahu ahead of White House meeting
results.description: Trump took a dig at Netanyahu, saying he did not need his updates on Iran and made it clear that he would prefer an agreement to war at this stage.
